title: Answer
description:
The many sons are led out as the son-people was led out, and the glory is not the land.

The leader goes through the suffering before the company is reached. Sanctifying is God's act, so the one who sanctifies and the sanctified are of one.

The praise among the brethren carries the forsaken cry and the nations turning. The children are signs, and the one who stands with them is the one who waits on God.
